sentences.en: "Poor things!" murmured the Queen softly. "What did you do?"
sentences.zh: 可怜的孩子！"女王轻声喃喃地说，"你们做了什么？

sentences.en: "I love you," she murmured and closed her eyes.
sentences.zh: "我爱你。"她喃喃地说完便闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: There was a murmur when she entered the room.
sentences.zh: 当她走进房间时，传来一阵低语声。

senses.zh: 低语；低语声；低声抱怨；潺潺声
